decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings titled Existing Elevation, Existing Floor Plans and Proposed Floor Plans, received on 23/01/2013, Design and Access Statement, received on 31/01/2013, Site Plan, received on 27/02/2013, Proposed Elevations (Sectional), received on 25/02/2013, Proposed Shed, received on 25/02/2013 and Proposed Elevations, received on 14/03/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, installation of an additional rear roof light and erection of an outbuilding in the rear garden.
